notes: Registration input, not a run input: Binance's ETH implied-volatility index (ETHBVOLUSDT), pulled exactly as source-binance-btcbvol.json (same transform, layout and knobs). Time: calc_time_ms is epoch ms (Kalshi candle ts is seconds); the first day (2023-06-20) is partial (ETHBVOL starts 00:11:40Z). LICENCE: Binance Vision data is CC BY-NC-SA (https://data.binance.vision/Binance_Vision-Terms_of_Use.pdf): research use only, not for live trading features. Dates: configs/binance_vision_dates.json, pinned by entities_sha256 (export CRYPTO_TRADING_ROOT=<this child's root>; no machine path is stored). The untouched vendor zip is kept at _raw/<date>.zip and its sha256 is the inventory raw_sha256: compare it with the vendor's <file>.zip.CHECKSUM (ADR-0238 withdrawn; manual spot check per runbook). HEAD sweep 2026-10-06 of every date in configs/binance_vision_dates.json: 26 days returned 404 (2023-09-25, 2023-10-24, 2024-06-11 to 2024-06-12, 2024-06-30, 2025-12-15 to 2026-01-04), the same 26 for BTC and ETH, so this pull always warns for them; max_refused 31 is those 26 plus 5 of headroom for a day missing at pull time. A day Binance lacks lands as a refused inventory row (suite-binance-files.json warns, never blocks) instead of aborting a pull of over a thousand files. throttle_s 0.1 is polite to a static archive; max_bytes 50 MB is a sanity cap (a daily zip is about 0.4 MB). A changed declaration (dates, pin or as_of) re-pulls; an unchanged one is a no-op. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source binance-ethbvol --catalog-source binance-ethbvol --connector httpblobs --config @configs/source-binance-ethbvol.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source binance-ethbvol --stream files --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-binance-files.json.
